tests.title: administrator setup/admission, human discussion, direct HTTP agent, nesting, revisions and responsive reading
a late committed publication cannot repopulate another identity or route after sign-out
lost committed response survives actual browser process restart and exact retry without duplication
late reads preserve navigation/account ownership; older-page failure and revoked rights preserve draft
overview uses ordinary artifact history/editors; text-artifact drafts survive navigation
